bio.text: Ben Ambrose is the Democratic nominee for Michigan's 2nd Congressional District in 2026, after advancing from the August 4 primary.
According to his campaign website, he was born in Muskegon, grew up on a farm in Hesperia, and served nearly 20 years in the U.S. Marine Corps as an infantryman.
His campaign website says he holds a B.A. in international affairs from Georgetown University and an MBA from Johns Hopkins University.
